PKGBUILD uses VCS git sources with all md5sums set to SKIP, which is standard for git packages. The prepare() function initializes and updates submodules, configures submodule URLs from the local source directory, and pulls LFS objects via git lfs install/pull – all expected packaging steps. The build() and package() functions run cmake and make with DESTDIR, installing files into $pkgdir. No eval, base64, curl, wget, or other dangerous commands are present. All network fetches are from the upstream GitHub repository of the project, which is the intended source. Consequently, there is no evidence of injected malicious code, data exfiltration, or backdoors.
